headline_of_the_week: UK Investing in Women Code proves the fix works: signatories deployed 32% of investment value to female-founded teams in 2025, more than double the 15% market baseline

headlines.title: UK Investing in Women Code: signatories deployed 32% vs 15% market baseline
headlines.summary: The sixth annual UK Investing in Women Code report shows signatories directed 32% of their investment value to female-founded teams in 2025, more than double the 15% UK market baseline. The signatory network grew from 12 firms in 2019 to 330+ today. Proof that public commitment, quarterly reporting, and measurement move the number.

headlines.title: British Business Bank deploys £90M to 10 microfunds, 57% female-led GPs
headlines.summary: Under the Investor Pathways programme, the British Business Bank confirmed £90M into 10 new microfunds this cycle, with 57% led by female GPs. Total pathway commitment now £100M into female-led funds. Structural LP deployment, not thematic marketing.

headlines.title: Databento closes $97M Series B led by NEA - Christina Qi builds Bloomberg competitor
headlines.summary: Databento raised $97M Series B led by NEA. Founder-CEO Christina Qi (former hedge-fund trader) is building a low-cost financial data platform to compete with Bloomberg and LSEG. Rare all-female-founded round at this scale, coming out of Utah.

headlines.title: AI boom widened the gender funding gap: 3% AI deal share for all-female teams
headlines.summary: As global AI funding drove record H1 2026 numbers, all-female founding teams received only 3% of AI deal share versus a 7% cross-sector average. The record capital cycle concentrated even further away from female founders. Narrative-building window before the AI-benefits-everyone consensus locks in.

headlines.title: Solo GP Ashley Smith closes Vermilion Cliffs Ventures Fund II at $25M
headlines.summary: Solo woman GP Ashley Smith closed her second fund at $25M targeting AI infrastructure, security, and dev tools. Solo woman GPs raising institutional capital remain scarce, and second funds are the harder milestone. Signal that the solo GP thesis is bankable for women.

headlines.title: Bayer Foundation Women Entrepreneurs Award: 15 winners from 1,172 applicants across 124 countries
headlines.summary: Bayer Foundation named 15 winners of its Women Entrepreneurs Award, selected from 1,172 applicants in 124 countries. Each receives €25K non-dilutive plus a six-month accelerator. Health and food security focus in underserved markets. Global non-dilutive at scale.

headlines.title: FutureFemHealth Q2 2026: $738.78M across 40 women's health rounds
headlines.summary: FutureFemHealth Q2 2026 analysis shows $738.78M invested across 40 women's health rounds. Largest rounds: CREATE Medicines $122M and Nourish $100M. Women's health continues as a resilient sub-sector.

headlines.title: European Prize for Women Innovators 2026 winners announced
headlines.summary: The 2026 European Prize for Women Innovators recognized Katerina Spranger (Oxford Heartbeat, €2.5M EIC grant), Marta Oliveira (ATMOS Space Cargo, €13.1M funding), and Ella Cullen (Minespider). EU deeptech capital continues to concentrate around policy-backed programs like EIC.
